steps.title: Click Pre-advise Export
steps.instruction: Pre-advise Export  is the process of sending advance information about an export container that is expected to arrive at the terminal.

steps.title: Click Equipment Number:
steps.instruction: Equipment Number is the unique identification number assigned to a container.

steps.title: Click [A unique number identifying the equipment.]
Click Equipment Type
steps.instruction: Equipment Type identifies the ISO number associated with the standard dimensions of a container

steps.title: Click [The equipment type ISO code. For information about ISO codes, see http:www.smdg.org/documents.]

steps.instruction: Line Operator is the shipping line responsible for the container and its associated booking

steps.title: Click [The controlling operator of the equipment.]
Click Gross Weight (kg):
steps.instruction: Gross Weight is the total weight of the container and the cargo inside it.

steps.title: Click navis
steps.instruction: Carrier Mode indicates how a container is being transported to the terminal.

steps.title: Click Booking Number:
steps.instruction: Booking Number is the unique reference number associated with the cargo booking.
